name: FastVideo FastH3 OmniRef — video with sound from reference pictures (8 steps)
description:
Give it up to four pictures — a character, a product, a place — and get a short film with its own soundtrack in which they appear. The model reuses what is in the pictures and invents the performance, the camera and the sound.

Pictures are numbered in the order of the upload slots, so fill them from the top: the second slot is <Picture 2>, and so on. An empty slot is removed from the graph.

Write the prompt in the model's sections, as in the default: **subject_definitions** ("<Subject 1> is the plane in <Picture 1>: …"), a one-line **summary**, **retention_analysis** (what must stay the same), **detailed_description** with one line per [Shot] and its timestamp, then **overall_soundscape** and **non_diegetic_music**. Naming the sounds is what gets a deliberate soundtrack.

This is FastVideo's FastH3 OmniRef, MiniMax H3 distilled to 8 steps for reference-to-video. Plain text-to-video works but is not its strength — use the FastH3 text-to-video card for that.

promptGuides.label: MiniMax H3 — reference-video prompt guide
promptGuides.tip: Define each <Subject N> from its <Picture N>, say what must be preserved, then write one line per [Shot] with its timestamp, and describe the sound.

author: Template - ComfyUI

exposedParameters.label: Prompt — define the subjects from <Picture N>, then the shots and the sound
exposedParameters.default:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the plane in <Picture 1>: a yellow propeller plane climbing vertically with a smoke trail.
<Subject 2> is the setting in <Picture 1>: a towering cumulus cloud against a near-black sky.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 5-second, multi-cut cinematic aviation film. The plane climbs vertically, stalls at the top and tumbles into a dramatic dive.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the yellow plane and white smoke trail are retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the towering cumulus and dark sky are retained.

detailed_description:
The target video is a striking, high-contrast aerial film with bright sunlit clouds, deep dark sky and dynamic camera moves.
[Shot 1] A wide shot matches <Picture 1>: <Subject 1> climbs straight up above <Subject 2>, smoke trail curling, and the camera tilts up with it.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a beautiful close-up of the propeller and yellow nose as it slows at the top; the plane stalls, flips over and the camera follows it diving toward the bright cloud.

overall_soundscape:
Straining engine, wind, a sudden silence at the stall and a roaring dive.

non_diegetic_music:
Tense rising strings that break into a thrilling crescendo.
